golden_why: resume: the block that grows until nothing reads it
description: A resuming session inherits a `## Resume` block the last move wrote as a narrative: `As of` runs to 929 characters and carries findings, asks, and a measurement caveat that the Tasks and the Log already hold. It writes the block as a block. The live tracker reached 19 044 characters in that field, with `resume_long=5` in every render for nine hours.

graders.name: block still has every field
graders.pattern: (?s)## Resume.*?- As of:.*?- In flight:.*?- Next:.*?- Waiting on:.*?- Re-arm:.*?- Verified

graders.name: As of is this move's clock read
the inherited narrative is gone from the block
the audit finding survived into the Log
tasks are not rewritten to make the block short
Log times are this move's clock reads
the board is re-rendered from the final tracker
